sql: WITH t AS (SELECT pnl, quantity, assumed_price, (100-assumed_price) AS yes_sold, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='mmsell' AND status='settled') SELECT CASE WHEN yes_sold IS NULL THEN 'ALL' WHEN yes_sold<10 THEN 'y 5-10c' WHEN yes_sold<20 THEN 'y 10-20c' WHEN yes_sold<35 THEN 'y 20-35c' WHEN yes_sold<50 THEN 'y 35-50c' ELSE 'y 50c+' END AS band, count(*) AS n, round(avg(yes_sold)::numeric,1) AS avg_yes, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS total_pnl, round(avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))::numeric*100,2) AS c_per_ct, round(avg((pnl>0)::int)::numeric*100,0) AS win_pct FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(1) ORDER BY band NULLS FIRST
